integrity: Algebraic proof and small exhaustive computational checks are included. Previous maximal-subalgebra and algebra-generation results are acknowledged. No publication priority or independent verification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite-dimensional unital associative F_q-algebras with one finite-field residue and radical square zero. The full Galois-isotypic rank law is conditional on generation of that residue; no arbitrary proper-residue profile is claimed. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: A Galois-twist rank law for random generation of square-zero local algebras
